preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Loan payments due'

column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT cl.id AS "id", cl.firstname AS "firstName", cl.middlename AS "middleName", cl.lastname AS "lastName", cl.display_name AS "fullName", cl.mobile_no AS "mobileNo", l.principal_amount AS "loanAmount", mo.id AS "officeNumber", (IFNULL(l.principal_outstanding_derived, 0) + IFNULL(l.interest_outstanding_derived, 0) + IFNULL(l.fee_charges_outstanding_derived, 0) + IFNULL(l.penalty_charges_outstanding_derived, 0)) AS "loanOutstanding", l.principal_disbursed_derived AS "loanDisbursed", MAX(ls.duedate) AS "latestPaymentDueDate", (IFNULL(SUM(ls.principal_amount), 0) - IFNULL(SUM(ls.principal_writtenoff_derived), 0) + IFNULL(SUM(ls.interest_amount), 0) - IFNULL(SUM(ls.interest_writtenoff_derived), 0) - IFNULL(SUM(ls.interest_waived_derived), 0) + IFNULL(SUM(ls.fee_charges_amount), 0) - IFNULL(SUM(ls.fee_charges_writtenoff_derived), 0) - IFNULL(SUM(ls.fee_charges_waived_derived), 0) + IFNULL(SUM(ls.penalty_charges_amount), 0) - IFNULL(SUM(ls.penalty_charges_writtenoff_derived), 0) - IFNULL(SUM(ls.penalty_charges_waived_derived), 0)) AS "totalDue", laa.total_overdue_derived AS "totalOverdue", l.account_no AS "loanAccountId", MAX(gua.lastname) AS "guarantorLastName", COUNT(DISTINCT gua.id) AS "numberOfGuarantors", gp.display_name AS "groupName" FROM m_office mo LEFT JOIN m_client cl ON mo.id = cl.office_id LEFT JOIN m_loan l ON cl.id = l.client_id LEFT JOIN m_group_client gc ON gc.client_id = cl.id LEFT JOIN m_group gp ON gp.id = l.group_id LEFT JOIN m_loan_repayment_schedule ls ON l.id = ls.loan_id LEFT JOIN m_guarantor gua ON gua.loan_id = l.id LEFT JOIN m_product_loan lp ON lp.id = l.product_id INNER JOIN m_loan_arrears_aging laa ON laa.loan_id = l.id WHERE mo.id = ${officeId} AND (${loanOfficerId} = -1 OR l.loan_officer_id = ${loanOfficerId}) AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ls.duedate) BETWEEN ${fromX} AND ${toY} AND mo.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT((SELECT ino.hierarchy FROM m_office ino WHERE ino.id = ${officeId}), '%') AND (${isIslamic} = -1 OR lp.is_islamic = ${isIslamic}) GROUP BY cl.id, cl.firstname, cl.middlename, cl.lastname, cl.display_name, cl.mobile_no, l.principal_amount, l.principal_disbursed_derived, l.account_no, l.id, mo.id, laa.total_overdue_derived, gp.display_name ORDER BY mo.hierarchy, l.currency_code, cl.account_no, l.account_no
